$comment: GOLDEN FACTS read from the source document BY EYE, NOT from FinSight output.
Annexure F: a QUARTERLY cash-flow statement (rare for an Indian filer),
present only as an image. Read from crops eternal_p19_a..d, _op and _fin.
The structural rows are transcribed -- operating subtotals, every
working-capital, investing and financing line, the section totals and the
cash walk. The ~20 non-cash adjustment lines between 'Profit before tax'
and 'Operating profit before working capital changes' are NOT transcribed
(see excluded_rows); facts extracted from them are reviewed as extras.
Two first readings of mine failed the identities (806 for 906; (387) for
(367)) and were corrected from 3-4x crops before this file was written.

Phase 22: every row carries 'metric', the canonical key its printed label names, decided by reading the label in its statement (null: the taxonomy has no key for the line); 'metric_alt' lists keys that name the same measure. The scorer checks the key, not only the printed label.

transcription.method: read by eye from 2.2-4.0x crops of an image-only page
